verdict.rationale: Featurebase ships 'Fibi', a built-in AI agent that autonomously resolves customer support tickets and provides instant AI answers, and also offers AI-assisted decluttering/prioritization of feedback — both indicate task delegation to an in-product AI assistant. However, evidence is mostly marketing copy (docs-7, docs-10, docs-14) with only the Training Data API (docs-26) as a technical backing; there's no first-party deep-dive on delegating arbitrary admin tasks or broader agentic workflows beyond support/ticket handling. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of Fibi's task delegation, and evidence of AI assistant capabilities beyond customer support/feedback triage.
